svg.text: Upper body hypertrophy + endurance — Session B
Focus block · 13 targets · shoulder, elbow, wrist at loading stage 2 · spine at 1 · ~59 min · 35 working sets
Before: upper mobility routine, pre half · then 1–2 light warm-up sets
Outside the exercise time (R19) · hypertrophy: current working loads; new exercises start at the stated RIR
Endurance: a load you could lift 15–18 times — 12–15 reps with 3 in reserve (Stage 0 §2.2)
A — Superset 1: Front delt + Rear delt (hypertrophy · ~17.5 min · 5 rounds · 60–90 s rest)
Front delt (S) · chest assists · thumbs up · stop at shoulder height
Soft elbow · both arms together · no torso swing
Band pull-apart hold at shoulder height, both arms
Rear delt (S) · upper back assists · palms down, arms at shoulder height
Hold with the hands in line with the shoulders · soft elbow · no shrug
B — Superset 2: Side delt + Abs (hypertrophy · ~17.5 min · 5 rounds · 60–90 s rest)
Side delt (S) · raise to 80°, just below shoulder height
Soft elbow · both arms together · no shrug
Dead bug hold, both arms and both legs up
Abs (M) · low back flat; arms over shoulders, hips 90°
Progress: straighten both legs only while the back stays flat
C — Superset 3: Upper back + Chest (endurance · ~6.5 min · 2 rounds + 1 set · ≤30 s rest)
Upper back (M) · rear delt, lats and biceps assist
Elbows flared to the shoulder line · reach ~90–95% · 3rd set alone (R39)
Chest (S) · start with the arms short of the torso plane
Hands meet at mid-chest · soft elbow · arms together
D — Superset 4: Triceps + Rotator cuff (endurance · ~5 min · 2 rounds · ≤30 s rest)
Triceps (M) · elbows at the sides · arms together
Soft elbow at the bottom, where the band is heaviest
Band external rotation, both arms (one band)
Rotator cuff (S) · elbows pinned to the sides with a towel
Turn out to ~70–80% of your range · both hands on one band
E — Superset 5: Forearm flexors + extensors (endurance · ~5 min · 2 rounds · ≤30 s rest)
Band wrist curl, both arms (forearms on the safety arm)
Forearm flexors (S) · rack's safety arm at hip height, palms up
Band under both feet, slack at the bottom · wrist ~70–80% of range
Band reverse wrist curl, both arms (forearms on the safety arm)
Forearm extensors (S) · set up as 9 Band wrist curl, palms down
Band slack at the bottom · wrist ~70–80% of range
F — Straight sets: Obliques (endurance · ~8 min · 2 sets · ≤30 s rest after each)
Obliques (M) · abs assist · press out and hold 2–3 s
Hips and ribs square · soft elbow · both sides equally
After: mobility post half · day after: no archery · day after: no badminton
Delts, abs, obliques, back, chest, triceps, cuff, forearms collect sets — archery's day-before muscles (R21)
Rotator cuff and forearms collect sets too — badminton's day-before muscles (R21)
Next day, train only if that morning's step gate passes for every joint both sessions load (R20)
A training day after shooting: the same gate, for every joint the shoot and this session load (R21)
Every rep, every set — hypermobility rules
Lower every rep over 2–3 s; keep a soft bend at every joint, no lockout (R25 · R2)
Peak effort at ~70–80% of your range, never end range: stage 2 opens full range, not end range (R1 · R3)
Skip the session if joints feel loose; end a set the moment a joint feels unstable (R9)
Hypertrophy: 2 RIR in weeks 1–4, 1 RIR from week 5 (R18) — week 1 = your first session
Endurance: 3 RIR every week (R17); rest ≤30 s after each pair, 60–90 s after hypertrophy pairs
Both arms together on every exercise: one-arm work waits for loading stage 3 (R12)
Holds: end ~8 s before failure (wk 5+: ~4 s); too easy at 60 s → harder variant, not longer (R16)
Progress: top of the rep range twice → your smallest load step, reps back to the bottom (R42)
Log the step gate after each session; a fail repeats last week's dose for that joint (§2.6 · R43)
Mobility pre half → warm-up sets → A → B → C → D → E → F → mobility post half
Exercise time ≈59 min (R40: 4 s a rep, top of every range, 90 s or 30 s rest by goal) · 35 working sets
Working sets — here · week (direct + half-sets from compounds)
Lower back 0 · week 0: a named gap, spine at stage 1
Alternatives — if a station is taken (each avoids the primary's stations, R41)
v13 — dead bug hold for the plank (card 4): the plank holds the side delt that the lateral raise trains (catalogue rev 18)
